meta.title: DSH Commands (dsh-commands)
meta.description: Adds git-kit Git workflows and handoff session transfer to DSH as native slash commands (skills are provided by the ai-kit repo): commit message, commit and push, branch, PR/MR create and merge, tag, post-merge release (tag, platform Release, effect verification), repository slimming, star classification, and a copy-paste resume prompt for a new session.
